drawing.title: Draw and edit the profile
drawing.intro: Build the part in a dimensioned workspace.
items: Free drawing and precise line-length / angle entry
Grid, Ortho and polar tracking; selectable Endpoint, Midpoint, Intersection and Nearest object snaps
Select, move, copy and rotate drawings; undo and redo
Horizontal/vertical Linear, Aligned, Angle and Radius measurements, alongside automatic dimensions
Offset drawings, mirror geometry and linked layers
Select and edit in Front, Top, Side or 3D views; numeric controls handle coordinates hidden by edge-on views
CAD import with units, outline / centerline review and part selection
Inspect manual measurement reference points; annotation text, arrows and lines scale with drawing zoom
Start empty or choose an editable L, Z, U, Hat or 45° offset profile; selected setup still governs calculation and checking
Internal drawing clipboard with Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V; placement, validation and Undo/Redo remain part of the workflow

calculation.title: Turn dimensions into a program
calculation.intro: Keep the drawing and machine values connected.
items: Material tables, thickness, workpiece width, die and punch setup
Outside, inside and centerline length references
Outside bend and inside-angle display conventions
Flat length, bend angles and True Length gauge positions
Guarded recalculation and preservation of compatible imported BEP data
Controller-value overrides with recalculation / recheck requirements
Profile reconstruction from complete, consistent machine values

machine.title: See the complete movement
machine.intro: Inspect the bends and the moves between them.
items: Machine and profile views with full-sequence playback
Bending, transfer, insertion, removal and assembly checks on supported models
Pause, seek, restart, playback speed and bend guides
Recorded collision positions marked precisely on the playback bar
Full 3D, Light 3D and Engineering 2D display options
Automatic quality reduction and fallback when 3D is unavailable
Background checks with progress, cancellation and stale-result invalidation

planning.title: Find a workable sequence
planning.intro: Review alternatives before changing the drawing.
items: Manual bend order and per-step end-for-end turns / face flips
Bounded alternative-order searches and defined-tool comparisons
Shape alternatives with supported dimension and angle constraints
Only fully checked collision-free candidates appear as usable results
Original / proposed comparison, preview, apply or create a copy
Guidance to change order or transfer path when no clear result exists

projects.title: Keep the whole project together
projects.intro: Organize multiple drawings and their placement.
items: Named projects and multiple drawings with independent setup
Drawing positions, rotation, multi-selection and collision status
Project playback with completed pieces retained in the assembly
Linked-layer master editing, regeneration and detachment
Portable project files and password-encrypted project export
Save guards, recovery copies and unsaved-work protection
Grid or list browsing with 48 projects per page, machine filtering and page selection; saved previews load for the visible page

tools.title: Work with your machine setup
tools.intro: Use the definitions and measurements you reviewed.
items: One Settings workspace for machine profiles, tools, travel calibration, component outlines, technology tables, drawing defaults and project storage
Machine profiles, per-project machine binding and new-project defaults
Tool dimensions, local definitions and measured component outlines
Controller-position and travel calibration with recorded limits
Per-machine confirmed Screen Length calibration for PDF only
Machine support descriptions and Automatic calculation mode
Material technology-table inspection and editing

export.title: Take the checked result to the shop
export.intro: Prepare the program and a readable setup sheet.
items: BEP export gated by the current supported full check
A4 setup sheets with machine, separate thickness and strip width, tooling and full-material before/after bend frames
Material, tools, dimensions, bend steps and True Length on the sheet
Optional Screen Length using the confirmed machine calibration
Batch export as BEP files, one combined PDF or both, with clear output names and per-drawing readiness review
Separate files for machine programs and portable projects

workspace.title: A workspace that feels familiar
workspace.intro: Keep useful copies and make the interface your own.
items: Local library of reusable profile and bending-program copies, with folders, search, previews and templates; complete projects are saved separately
Duplicate, rename, move, delete and undo library actions
English, Arabic, German, French and Italian interfaces
Arabic right-to-left layout, Light / Dark themes and saved appearance
Resizable editor panels and keyboard drawing commands
Offline activation, time-limited / lifetime licenses and a 3-day trial
Help menu with application information and license management

faq: Does Engineering 2D change the check results?
No. Display quality changes the presentation. The full checking engine and its approval requirements stay the same.
Does every machine support BEP export?
No. Available calculations and checks depend on the selected machine. BEP export requires supported full geometry and a current completed collision-free check.
Can I use my existing files?
Bendorithm opens compatible BEP programs and portable project files. CAD import includes review of units, geometry interpretation, strip width, material and tools.
The Windows application supports offline, device-bound activation and a 3-day trial. Trial setup may require administrator permission once. Contact Bendorithm@gmail.com for licensing.

Bendorithm can check for a published Windows update at startup and download it automatically when a signed update is available. Installation still requires your approval: save your work and close Bendorithm before continuing in the installer. Public downloads depend on an approved published release.
No. Checks use the supplied model, measurements and sampled motion positions. Verify tooling, material behavior, machine limits and physical setup before production.
Will there be macOS and Linux versions?
Yes, macOS and Linux are planned. The current build has been developed and tested on Windows. Other platforms require completed platform support and testing before downloads can be offered.
